features.name: connector_count
features.definition: How many occurrences of the formal reasoning connectors therefore, hence or thus appear across all counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings. If missing or malformed, return null. If the list is empty return 0. Otherwise, across all comments, count case-insensitive whole-word regex matches of r'\b(therefore|hence|thus)\b' and sum them. Raw text count, no semantic filtering; no stemming or other connectors.

h0: connector_count has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher connector_count is associated with a lower probability of delta, i.e. fewer connectors go with more persuasion.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view). Connectors are limited to the three listed words; other connectors are not counted. Count is raw, not length-normalized, so longer comment sets have more opportunity; length is not controlled. OC_comments are current text, may include post-outcome content; comment order/timing unknown. Association only.
